`openadapt quickstart --break-it` is the two-minute proof.

OpenAdapt compiles a demonstrated GUI task into a program that reports VERIFIED only if an independent check agrees. Recording authors. Receipt proves. Program is the company.

`--break-it` reruns the same certified MockMed bundle against a backend that paints a success banner and then rejects the write. Every on-screen check still passes. The independent read of the system of record doesn't. The engine HALTs at the consequential step. Evidence lands in a local `run-broken/REPORT.md`. There's no shareable receipt, because that rail is reserved for VERIFIED runs.

```bash
pip install openadapt
openadapt quickstart
openadapt quickstart --break-it
```

I expected the banner to be enough. It wasn't.
